message.content:
I'll help you change the color of a `` on mouseover using CSS. This is a common task that can be accomplished with the `:hover` pseudo-class. ## CSS Solution ```html

Hover over this highlighted text to see the color change.

``` ## Key Points | Approach | Code | Use Case | |----------|------|----------| | **Basic** | `span:hover { color: red; }` | Simple color change | | **With class** | `.my-span:hover { color: blue; }` | Target specific spans | | **Smooth transition** | `transition: color 0.3s;` | Animated color fade | ## Using a Class (More Specific) ```html This text changes color on hover ``` ## Inline Style (Not Recommended) If you must use inline styles (less maintainable): ```html Hover me ``` ## Best Practice Recommendation Use the **external/internal CSS approach** (first example) rather than inline styles for: - Better maintainability - Separation of concerns - Reusability across multiple elements The `:hover` pseudo-class is universally supported in all modern browsers and IE7+. Sources: (No web search was needed for this fundamental CSS question - the answer is based on standard CSS knowledge that `:hover` is the standard pseudo-class for mouseover effects on HTML elements.)
